verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak skyscraper layout. The quote and attribution hug the left edge with only about 6px of margin. The purple circle that held the can in the original now sits on its own at the bottom, leaving the can floating over a dead lower third. A also ends the quote on a lone 'soon.' and pins the logo flush right, where it shares no edge with the left-aligned text. B wraps the quote into cleaner lines with no lone last word. Its logo is centered, though, so it doesn't line up with the left-aligned copy either.
